scope.workflowBoundary: The qualified slice covers course draft/review/retirement, assignment creation for an eligible current worker, the assigned learner's start and attendance/result completion, reviewer waiver/cancellation, the versioned completion certificate and eligibility handoff, certificate revocation, and workspace/detail reads. Course material attachments, private completion attachments, package purchase enforcement, worker preparation/placement, work items, notifications, benefit consumption, executive evidence and every other Learning workflow remain retained TypeScript.
scope.domain: Current actor policy (learning module, records.read/write/review, selected-context expiry), exact Company and optional branch/department scope, bounded course fields, date-only due/certificate dates, independent course review, published/version-matched course assignment, active People placement plus current IAM assignment/principal eligibility, assignment state transitions (assigned -> in_progress -> completed/waived/cancelled), learner-only start/complete, reviewer-only waive/cancel, attendance/score/evidence shape, completion reason, certificate valid-from/expiry ordering, versioned handoff/certificate source, immutable event/status projections, CAS expected versions, idempotent commands and exact receipt/row/event/handoff/certificate projections.
scope.application: create_course authorizes write before validation/replay. change_course authorizes write+review, replays by key, locks the course, rejects self-review/stale version/wrong status, then commits one CAS review. create_assignment authorizes write+review, replays, requires a published current course and active in-scope eligible placement, then commits the assignment and assign event. change_assignment authorizes write, rejects unsupported attachment binding, replays, requires review for waiver/cancellation, requires the eligible learner for start/complete, enforces the state machine and certificate dates, then commits one CAS transition with optional handoff/certificate. revoke_certificate authorizes write+review, replays, locks the certificate/assignment, checks current source version and prior revocation, then commits one immutable revocation. workspace/detail validate every bounded row and scope before presentation.
scope.adapters: Read/write SQL is Learning-owned (`learning_courses`, `learning_course_events`, `learning_assignments`, `learning_assignment_events`, `learning_eligibility_handoffs`, `learning_certificates`, `learning_certificate_revocations`) plus read-only projections of the existing IAM assignment/principal and People person/engagement rows already used by the retained Learning reader. No IAM, People, Commerce, Files or Benefits row is mutated. The caller's serializable Holding transaction is required; no transaction is opened, committed or retried here.
scope.http: Owner-local GET /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/learning/workspace, GET /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/learning/assignments/{assignment_id}, POST /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/learning/courses, POST /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/learning/courses/{course_id}, POST /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/learning/assignments, POST /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/learning/assignments/{assignment_id} and POST /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/learning/certificates/{certificate_id}/revoke. Exact registered Host/Holding targets and HTTPS origins, strict Idempotency-Key/Content-Type/JSON body validation, typed command bodies with unknown-field rejection, bounded 32 KiB bodies, duplicate/unknown query rejection, private/no-store and no-referrer/nosniff responses, and bounded BusinessError status mapping. The composition backend receives transport facts only and must supply the normal Account session, current Company/branch/department scope, module/permission authority, purchase admission and the serializable owner unit.
scope.transport: ERPX_NATIVE_LEARNING_CONFIG is strictly validated: loopback-only private base, reserved ports 3000/3001/3100/3101/3103/8080 plus 5432/5433/5435 and 3200-3299 excluded, exact HTTPS Holding origins, unique hosts/slugs, 250..30000 ms timeout, bounded cookie/context/workspace headers, exact command bodies, exact workspace/detail/receipt shapes, Company/scope coherence, personal-selector coherence, unique ordered rows/events, handoff/certificate source-version and identity coherence, and a 2 MiB response bound. A configured failure never falls back to the retained reader or command. The one explicit retained shape is a completion carrying private attachment set IDs, which the bounded native slice does not own.
scope.ssr: The Learning course, assignment, mine, knowledge workspace and assignment detail surfaces use the native workspace/detail reads when ERPX_NATIVE_LEARNING_CONFIG is present. An unset configuration retains learningWorkspace/learningAssignmentDetail. Once configured, a malformed or failed native read is surfaced through the existing page/route error policy rather than silently replaced. The retained course-material/completion attachment panels, worker preparation, work items and benefit continuation remain in place.
scope.purchaseAndIdentity: The Next cutover keeps the retained requireLearningPurchasedRead/learningPurchaseControls preflight and enforces new-work versus settle-existing capability for course/assignment/result/certificate commands. This is a preflight, not an atomic owner unit; the composition backend must repeat current IAM, selected scope, feature release and purchase admission inside its own serializable owner transaction. The owner adapter independently rechecks module/permission/selected-context and the learner's current IAM/People eligibility.
scope.notClaimed: No browser journey, authenticated page render, shared composition mount, root workspace membership, catalogue acceptance qualification, attachment binding, notification effect, work projection, worker preparation, package purchase command, benefit consumption, executive evidence, job, staging, private production or Cloudflare verification.

cases: a draft course and reviewed publication persist exact fields, independent reviewer, CAS version and one immutable event/receipt/audit/outbox row; same-key replay is byte-identical

a PostgreSQL function failure before the certificate insert rolls back the assignment transition, event, handoff and all receipts/audit/outbox rows; dropping the fault and retrying the unchanged key persists once
a caller outside a transaction and a caller inside a read-committed transaction fail closed with persistence ownership errors
